title: Input schema for the youtube-search-scraper actor
description: Scrape YouTube search results using a search term, or directly input a video, channel, or results page URL. Feel free to try it out with our default settings by hitting ▷ Start. If you need any help, have a read through this tutorial.

searchQueries.title: Search terms
searchQueries.description: Enter search terms just like you would enter it in YouTube's search bar.

maxResults.title: Maximum videos per search term
maxResults.description: Limit the number of videos you want to crawl. If you scrape a channel, acts as a limit for regular videos.

maxResultsShorts.title: Maximum shorts per search term
maxResultsShorts.description: Limit the number of Shorts videos you want to crawl.

maxResultStreams.title: Maximum streams per search term
maxResultStreams.description: Limit the number of Stream videos you want to crawl.

startUrls.title: Direct URLs
startUrls.description:
Enter a link to a YouTube video, channel, playlist or search results page. You can also import a CSV file or Google Sheet with a list of URLs.
Note: Input from Search term will be ignored when using this option. If you only want to scrape shorts/streams, set Maximum search results to 0, otherwise they represented number of regular videos requested

transcriptionAndSubtitle.title: Transcription & subtitles
transcriptionAndSubtitle.description: Choose whether to download subtitles, transcribe the video using speech-to-text AI, or both. Leave empty to skip subtitles and transcription. Subtitles are added to the dataset items, while transcripts are stored in the key-value store
enumTitles: Only download subtitles (when present on the video)
Download subtitles + transcribe videos without subtitles (using speech-to-text models) ($)

subtitlesLanguage.title: Subtitle language
subtitlesLanguage.description:
Language to download subtitles in.
Note: a subtitle-downloading option must be selected in Transcription & subtitles for this to work.

subtitlesFormat.title: Subtitle format
subtitlesFormat.description: Select in what format you want to download subtitles

sortingOrder.title: Sorting order
sortingOrder.description: Select Youtube sorting parameter for search
sortingOrder.sectionDescription:
Specify the parameters you want to sort/filter videos by. They will be applied as if you manually did so on Youtube's search page. Only works if you provide search term, not for the direct URLs.
 
 ⚠️ Using YouTube filters may mix Shorts with regular videos. This is a limitation on YouTube's side. We recommend checking it manually.

dateFilter.title: Date filter
dateFilter.description: Select Youtube upload date filter for search

videoType.title: Video type filter
videoType.description: Select Youtube video type filter for search

lengthFilter.title: Length filter
lengthFilter.description: Select Youtube video length filter for search

isHD.title: HD
isHD.description: Will apply the HD filter for search
isHD.groupDescription: What you could select under the Features section of the Filtering&Sorting menu on Youtube

hasSubtitles.title: Subtitles/CC
hasSubtitles.description: Will apply the Subtitles/CC filter for search

hasCC.title: Creative Commons
hasCC.description: Will apply the Creative Commons filter for search

is3D.title: 3D
is3D.description: Will apply the 3D filter for search

isLive.title: Live
isLive.description: Will apply the Live filter for search

isBought.title: Purchased
isBought.description: Will apply the Purchased filter for search

is4K.title: 4K
is4K.description: Will apply the 4K filter for search

is360.title: 360 degrees
is360.description: Will apply the 360 degrees filter for search

hasLocation.title: Location
hasLocation.description: Will apply the Location filter for search

isHDR.title: HDR
isHDR.description: Will apply the HDR filter for search

isVR180.title: VR180
isVR180.description: Will apply the VR180 filter for search

oldestPostDate.title: Scrape videos published after [date]
oldestPostDate.description: Only posts uploaded after or on this date will be scraped. Alternatively, specify how old the scraped videos should be in days. Putting 1 day will get you only today's posts, 2 days - yesterday's and today's, and so on. Note, that if you select this, sorting parameter will be auto-reset to NEWEST
oldestPostDate.sectionCaption: 📅 Date range (applicable only to scraping by channels URL) ($)

sortVideosBy.title: Sort by
sortVideosBy.description: Maps to the sorting buttons on the top of the channel's 'Videos', 'Shorts' and 'Live' pages.

aiVideoDescription.title: Add-on: AI video description ($)
aiVideoDescription.description: If enabled, uses AI to generate a time-segmented description of the video, covering both visual and audio content for each segment.

aiVideoSummary.title: Add-on: AI video summary ($)
aiVideoSummary.description: If enabled, uses AI to generate a concise conceptual summary of the video covering both visual and audio content.

saveSubsToKVS.title: Save subtitles to key-value store
saveSubsToKVS.description: If set to true, the scraper will save the downloaded subtitles to the key-value store. Transcripts are always saved to the key-value store

preferAutoGeneratedSubtitles.title: Prefer automatically generated subtitles.
preferAutoGeneratedSubtitles.description: If set to true, automatically generated subtitles are preferred to user subtitles. Note: a subtitle language must be selected and a subtitle-downloading option must be selected in Transcription & subtitles for this to work.
